summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Financial Valuation of Oil and Gas Reserves. Gain critical insights and skills to excel in the energy sector.
lede: Oil and gas reserves valuation combines production forecasts, costs, fiscal terms and discounted cash-flow analysis to estimate asset value. It is for upstream finance managers, reservoir engineers and commercial analysts who need to translate reserve estimates into investment valuations. Participants work with decline-curve forecasts, production-sharing cash flows, discounted cash-flow models and Monte Carlo simulations to assess value and uncertainty.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically structured for professionals operating at the intersection of subsurface engineering, corporate finance, and energy investment strategy.
modules: Foundations of Petroleum Economics and SPE-PRMS
Production Forecasting and Decline Curve Analysis
Fiscal Regimes and Production Sharing Contracts
ESG Integration and Carbon Adjusted Valuations
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (ability to build linked financial models, use logical functions, and structure cash flow waterfalls). Basic working knowledge of corporate finance principles, specifically Net Present Value (NPV) and Internal Rate of Return (IRR). Familiarity with general upstream oil and gas terminology (e.g., upstream, midstream, CAPEX, OPEX, reserves). No advanced programming or coding experience is required.
